Currency.Name: Bits, Bytes and Chunks
Currency.Hint: Use Ferrond's money on the character sheets: Bits, Bytes and Chunks (8 Bits = 1 Byte, 8 Bytes = 1 Chunk). Switches off the Quantum currency of dh-ikonis. Turn this off to keep another currency.

Tech.Name: Tech instead of Magic damage
Tech.Hint: Ferrond knows only physical and tech damage. Renames Daggerheart's magic damage to Tech (name and icon in the Homebrew settings; the rules stay the same). A name you set there yourself is kept.

Currency.IkonisOff: Motherboard: Ferrond switched off "Enable Quantum Currency" in dh-ikonis, so the sheets keep Bits, Bytes and Chunks.

Scrap.ValueHint: Worth of one piece: Shards in Bits, Metals in Bytes, Components in Chunks.

Reward.Title: Scrap Reward
Reward.DCHint: DC {easy} Easy · {standard} Standard · {difficult} Difficult · {veryDifficult} Very Difficult. The column is picked from the DC.
Reward.RemnantsHint: How many machines were among the enemies – or are lying around in the place being searched. Gutters and Syfters count as no remnants.
Reward.DiceHint: Dice per character, from the loot table. Change any number for this release only.
Reward.NoCharacters: No player characters in this world.

Card.Speaker: Scrap
Card.Title: Scrap released
Card.Hint: Rolled at the table? Type your results. Empty fields are rolled here.
Card.BadInput: Enter a number from 1 to {die}, or leave the field empty.

Claim.NoRelease: This scrap release no longer exists.
Claim.Already: This scrap has already been taken.
Claim.NotYours: You can only take scrap for your own character.
Claim.BadResult: The dice results do not fit this release.

Table.Title: Loot Table
Table.MenuHint: How many Shards, Metals and Components each player rolls, by remnants and difficulty.
Table.Intro: Dice for EACH player. Rows: how many remnants (machines) were among the enemies or are in the place being searched. Columns: how hard the fight was, or the Difficulty of a search. Each cell: Shards · Metals · Components.

Sell.Title: Sell {name}
Sell.NeedsGM: Scrap is sold in town. The GM has to approve the sale.
Sell.Waiting: Asked the GM. Waiting for an answer …
Sell.Denied: The GM did not approve the sale.
Sell.NoItem: This scrap item no longer exists.
Sell.NotYours: You can only sell scrap of your own character.
Sell.Changed: The inventory changed in the meantime. Please try again.

GM.Offline: The GM has to be online for this.
GM.OnlyGM: Only the GM can do this.

Shop.Title: Scrap Shack
Shop.Name: Name
Shop.StatusClosed: Closed. Check the stock, then open the shop.
Shop.ManagerHint: Stock per piece, rolled like the SRD: 1d10 of each Shard, 1d8 of each Metal, 1d6 of each Component. Change any number. While the shop is open, players buy and sell without asking; every trade is posted in the chat.
Shop.Closed: No scrap shack is open right now.
Shop.NoCharacter: You have no character to trade with.
Shop.BuyDone: Bought. The scrap is in your inventory.
Shop.OutOfStock: The shop does not have that many any more.
Shop.NotYours: You can only trade for your own character.

Ikonis.Name: Ikonis
Ikonis.BondedHint: Bonded: + your level to damage with this weapon.
Ikonis.InstallHint: Augments from this character's inventory. Swap them during downtime.
Ikonis.RemoveHint: Take {augment} out of {weapon}? It goes back into the inventory.
Ikonis.NoAugmentsHint: No augment in the inventory that is not installed yet.
Ikonis.NotIkonisHint: This weapon is not an {ikonis}. An {ikonis} is bound to its person, has Bonded and grows through augments.
Ikonis.MakeHint: {weapon} becomes an {ikonis}, bound to the character that carries it, and gets Bonded.
Ikonis.PresetHint: Iconic Weapon stats of the Motherboard frame. The trait is only used with a preset.
Ikonis.UnmakeHint: {weapon} stops being an {ikonis}. Its augments go back into the inventory.
Ikonis.NotSameOwner: The augment must be in the inventory of the character who carries the weapon.
Ikonis.NotYours: You do not own this weapon.
Ikonis.AlreadyInstalled: This augment is already installed – the same augment does not work twice.
Ikonis.DisableDhIkonis: Motherboard: Ferrond now brings its own {ikonis}. Please disable the module dh-ikonis and reload; Ferrond then removes its leftovers.
Ikonis.CleanedUp: dh-ikonis leftovers removed ({weapons} weapons, {features} homebrew features).
